guarantees.claim: add_round_key_in is assigned state_q when add_rk_sel is ADD_RK_INIT, mix_columns_out when ADD_RK_ROUND, shift_rows_out when ADD_RK_FINAL, and state_q by default.

assumptions.claim: add_rk_sel is driven to a valid non-default value (ADD_RK_INIT, ADD_RK_ROUND, ADD_RK_FINAL) in normal operation cycles.
assumptions.risk: A fallback to the default path switches the AddRoundKey input to state_q, which may be wrong for the current round and produce an incorrect ciphertext.

uncertain_points.claim: The complete legal enumeration of add_rk_sel is not visible; if more valid states exist (e.g., idle, rekey, extra AES rounds), the default assignment to state_q could mask an illegal control value and silently corrupt the data path.
uncertain_points.cond: if add_rk_sel takes an unlisted legal value
uncertain_points.risk: Silent data-path corruption without hardware error reporting, potentially breaking AES correctness.
